detail.noExe.text: Sizingatheke kuzindikirika kudzera mu ndondomeko. Dinani “Sinthani nkhokwe ya deta” pambuyo pake: Discord ikangowonjezera exe, masewerawa apezeka.

settings.title: Zokonda
settings.language.desc: Chilankhulo cha mawonekedwe. Zilankhulo zatsopano zimawonjezedwa ngati mafayilo mufoda ya locales.
settings.defaultTime.desc: Mphindi zingati zosungira ndondomekoyi (ntchito za Discord nthawi zambiri zimafuna 15).
settings.tray.desc: Ma decoy amapitiriza kugwira ntchito pulogalamuyi ikakhala mu thireyi.
settings.source.desc: Mndandanda wapadera wa Discord · masewera {n} · zasinthidwa {date}
settings.showNoExe.desc: Zolowa zomwe Discord sidzidziwa ndondomeko yake (sizingathe kuyambitsidwa).
settings.dataDir.desc: Komwe mndandanda wamasewera ndi zokonda zimasungidwa.
settings.dataDir.portable: Mawonekedwe a portable: chilichonse chimasungidwa pafupi ndi decoy.exe.
settings.legal: Decoy siigwiritsa ntchito tokeni yanu ya Discord ndipo silandira ma quest m'malo mwanu. Kutengera ndondomeko ya masewera kungakhale kusemphana ndi malamulo a Discord, gwiritsani ntchito mwakufuna kwanu.
toast.launched: “{name}” yayambitsidwa kwa mphindi {n}. Discord iyenera kuzindikira pakadutsa pafupifupi masekondi 15.
toast.refreshUpToDate: Nkhokwe ya deta ndi yatsopano kale
lab.title: Labu
lab.subtitle: Tabu yachinsinsi: imayambitsa ma decoy ambiri nthawi imodzi.
lab.count.desc: Masewera amasankhidwa mwachisawawa, omwe akuyenda kale amadumphedwa. Iliyonse imayenda kwa mphindi {n} (yokhazikitsidwa mu Zokonda).
lab.warn: Decoy iliyonse ndi ndondomeko yosiyana yokhala ndi zenera. Kupitilira 200–300 nthawi imodzi kungachepetse liwiro la kompyuta yanu, malire ndi {max}.
